items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:49:1
items.html: The measure of the time in which the light is Lo Mati in a Sefira is a single moment: That is, that the measure of the time of the departure of the light from the whole Partzuf is a moment — namely the time of the ascent of the lights as MAN to the vessel of Keter, to the ZON that are there; for then there is no coupling in the Partzuf, since the screen has refined of all its coarseness, as above, and it is therefore discerned as a time of wrath. And he informs us by this that the matter of Mati and Lo Mati in the Partzuf is found to revolve this way and that without cease; for at that very moment of Lo Mati in Malchut, the lights immediately rise to the ZON of Keter, and the posterior of Bina immediately returns to its place, and the coarseness of phase two returns, and the light of the level of Bina is immediately Mati in Keter. So that this whole matter is like a flame that flickers this way and that, for the darkness that occurs in the Partzuf during the ascent of the lights as MAN, before the coupling is made, is a very short time.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:49:2
items.html:
Because of wrath, and because of the lower ones who have no power, etc., and in order to make a vessel. All these three reasons are one and the same thing, and it is what our sages said: at first it arose in the thought to create the world with the quality of judgment; He saw that the world would not endure, and He gave precedence to the quality of mercy and associated it with the quality of judgment (see in the Inner Light, Part 4, Chapter 1, section 4). The explanation is that the root of the quality of judgment is phase four, and it is she who emerged first, in the first expansion, where there was only one vessel, that of Malchut, of the aspect of the coarseness of phase four; and this is the secret of “it arose in the thought to create the world with the quality of judgment.” Except that He saw that the world would not endure — that the lower ones have no power to receive the light from so harsh a measure — and He therefore associated with her the quality of mercy, which is the secret of the aspect of Bina, who is everywhere called the quality of mercy, as is known. And to this they hinted in the Zohar, Ruth, in the secret of the words “and the two of them went,” which are the two Heys of the name HaVaYaH that were included as one, study it there. And this is as explained, that the first Hey of the name HaVaYaH is the aspect of Bina and the last Hey of the name HaVaYaH is the aspect of Malchut, and that for the correction of the world the two of them were associated together, that is, the quality of mercy with the quality of judgment, as above.
And this matter of association was not done all at once, but little by little, in the order of the cascading of the Partzufim and the degrees; and all this work was done through the departure of the lights. For at the time of the first departure the screen of phase four had already begun to be included in the first nine Sefirot, through its ascent from degree to degree until its arrival at the Emanator. And there too the chief force of judgment vanished from the screen, for phase four left no record for the drawing of the lights, as above. And out of this a root was made for the division of a degree into male and female; for only half a record of phase four returned to the second expansion, that is, the record of clothing, and it is this that became the aspect of the male of the vessel of Keter of the second expansion. And it is indeed discerned as half a thing, lacking the aspect of the drawing of the lights, and it therefore became bound to the degree of phase three, which would complete it in the aspect of drawing. And understand that from here is drawn the secret, in the lower worlds, that a male without a female is half a body. And these ZON of that vessel of Keter are the beginning of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, for phase three is discerned as the quality of mercy relative to phase four. And this matter is carried through there in all four pairs of male and female that are in that second expansion. And afterwards, in the second departure, the aspect of the record of drawing of phase three likewise vanished, and nothing remained but phase two — except that the male of phase three, of the aspect of clothing, was associated with her in the vessel of Keter, as above. And this association is carried through here too in all four pairs of male and female that are in this Partzuf of Bina. However, it could not yet be completed until the emergence of Bina outside the GAR and her coming to the aspect of VAK; and this was prepared through the Mati and Lo Mati that revolves in this Partzuf of Bina, as is written in its place. And then the world of Nekudim emerged, where Bina has already emerged from the aspect of GAR to the aspect of VAK — except that there was there the secret of the breaking of the vessels, and the matter was completed in the world of correction, in the world of Atzilut, where the association of the quality of mercy with the quality of judgment emerged in all its completeness, as is written in its place.
And you see how the Mati and Lo Mati that is in this Partzuf is the source of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment. And this is what he says, that the matter of the departure of the light, which revolves always by reason of the Mati and Lo Mati, is “because of wrath,” that is, because of the severity of the judgment that is in phase four, and the world does not endure in it, as above in the words of our sages. And it is “because of the lower ones who have no power,” which is likewise the same thing, namely that the world cannot endure in it. And it is “in order to make a vessel,” that is, that the essence may clothe in it in such a way that there be no further refinement and departure of the lights — which is achieved only at the completion of the association of the quality of mercy and the quality of judgment together, and not before; for until then the lights kept departing in every Partzuf, as above, and the vessels were not fit for their task. And this is what he says, “in order to make a vessel.” Thus all these three reasons that the ARI states are one and the same thing.

The deeds of human beings — so will the duration of that life be. And understand that the intention here is not the order of the emanation of the Partzufim from above downward, for there are as yet no human beings here who could spoil or correct. Rather the intention is upon this present time, after the four worlds are as they should be; then the deeds of the lower ones can lengthen the upper life in this Partzuf, or shorten it. For good deeds draw an abundance of bounty, and it is known that every renewal of bestowal must be drawn from Ein Sof — so that if a person causes by his deeds a renewal of bestowal, it is drawn from Ein Sof and passes through the world of the restriction, and from there to the first Partzuf of AK, and from there to the second Partzuf of AK, and from there to this third Partzuf, in which the matter of Mati and Lo Mati is fixed, and from here to the rest of the degrees in the four worlds ABYA, and it comes to this world to be received by the person.
And therefore, if the deed is in all its completeness, then at the time when the bounty passes through this Partzuf of Bina and revolves there in the ways of Mati and Lo Mati, that degree to which the bounty belongs, when the time of the Mati arrives in that degree, does not pass from there quickly but lengthens the time for it; and thereby the bounty is found to widen the time of reception also when it reaches the person in this world — and this is called that the life of the person is lengthened. And if the deed is indeed flawed, then the bounty is found there in a very short revolution; for when the bounty is Mati in the degree that belongs to it, it does not lengthen the time, but immediately comes into the state of Lo Mati. And this causes that, when the bounty reaches the person in this world, he cannot hold on to it except for a very short time. And this is the secret that the wicked are short of days and sated with wrath. And understand this. However, one must remember here the meaning of time in spirituality, which was explained in the Inner Observation in Part 1, at its end.
50) Three degrees, and this does not apply in the GAR: This was already explained in the Inner Light above, on the words of the ARI (page 311): that two conditions are required for the completion of the vessel. The first is the completion of the outer half of the wall, which is the aspect of the place for the reception of surrounding light. For since there is no light that does not have an inner part and a surrounding part, there is likewise no vessel that does not have an inner vessel and an outer vessel, so that it be fit to receive the two aspects that are in the light. And therefore the ARI calls them by the name of the two halves of the wall (above, Part 4, Chapter 5, item 5), for it is a necessary condition in the wall of the vessel, that is, in the aspect of the fitness of the vessel to be able to receive some light within it. And this is the first condition. And the second condition is that it be at some time empty of all light, even of the aspect of surrounding light; for the departure of the light makes it into a vessel.
And therefore, in the first expansion, vessels were made only for the seven lower ones, who are ZON. For Malchut, who attained the inner NRNHY in completeness at the time of the expansion, therefore attained the first surrounding light upon her ascent to ZA, and the second surrounding light upon her ascent to Bina; and upon her ascent to Hochma she received no further light at all, as the ARI says (Part 4, Chapter 6, item 15). And therefore, when she came to Hochma, having then grown distant three degrees from her own vessel — which are Hochma, Bina and ZA — the two above conditions were fulfilled, for she had already attained the outer half of the wall for the reception of the two surrounding lights, and she receives no further light; and therefore her vessel was completed. However, ZA is not completed before its arrival at the Emanator, since at the time of the ascent of ZA to Keter it still receives there the second surrounding light, and if so there is not yet a complete departure of the light from its vessel; only afterwards, when it departed from Keter too and came to the Emanator, then its vessel darkened and was completed.
However, the GAR, who are KHB, received there in the first expansion no surrounding lights, nor was the light entirely cut off from them, for even Bina, upon her arrival at Keter, still receives there the aspect of her inner Yechida. And therefore they lack the two conditions, and therefore no vessels were made for the GAR in that first expansion.

items.html:
The choicest part clothes inside Hochma, and what has darkened a little because of the distance of the lights from there — that remains in the aspect of a vessel. That is, that the record is composed of light and vessel, like the whole of the light from which it remained. And you already know the words of the ARI above (Part 4, Chapter 6, item 2), that in the first expansion, before it departed, the lights were mixed with the vessels and there is no discernment of a vessel there; and therefore the records that remained of those lights were likewise mixed of light and vessel together (see in Part 4, in the Inner Observation, item 48). And all the more so the vessels of the GAR, where even the vessels themselves are not yet reckoned as vessels, as above.
And therefore, now, when the lights returned in the second expansion and a male and female came into the vessel of Keter — the male being of the aspect of the record of the light of Keter of the first expansion — the record is divided into its two aspects, light and vessel: the choicest part in it, that is, the aspect of the light, becomes the aspect of the light of the male of the vessel of Keter; and the inferior part in it, which is the aspect of the vessel that had been mixed in it, separates from it because of the light of Hochma that likewise clothed in that vessel of Keter. And since the light of Hochma clothed in the vessel of the record, Hochma is found to interpose between the light of the record and its vessel; and then that vessel darkened and the aspect of a vessel was completed in it, as the ARI says.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:49:5
items.html:
Their expansion now is what causes these GAR to become a vessel. For the light of Hochma that clothed in the vessel of Keter interposed between the light and the vessel of the record, whereby the record of the first expansion, too, was weakened. And as long as the record is whole, the vessel is still strengthened by the record in it, even after the light has grown distant from her by three degrees; but now the aspect of the record, too, has been weakened, after the aspect of the vessel in her was subtracted from her, as above. And she also thereby attains the aspect of the outer half of the wall, for the vessel was included also of phase three by virtue of her clothing the light of Hochma, which is phase three, and which is the externality relative to phase four. And in this manner the vessel of Hochma of the first expansion, in which the light of Bina now clothed, attains through it the outer half of the wall, for the light of Bina is phase two, which is the externality relative to the vessel of Hochma, which is phase three. And in this manner the vessel of Bina of the first expansion, in which the light of ZA clothed, attains through it her outer half of the wall, for the light of ZA is phase one, which is the externality relative to phase two. Thus the vessels of the GAR were made through the present second expansion, and the very expansion causes them to become vessels.
And the ARI states here three reasons for the completion of the vessels of the GAR. The first is by reason of the emergence and the distancing of the choice light of the record from the coarse and inferior light in it, so that the coarse light of the record becomes a complete vessel. The second is by reason of the arrival of the new light of Hochma, which clothes in that same coarse light of the record and mediates and interposes between the choice light of the record and the coarse light of the record, whereby the coarse light becomes a complete vessel. The third is by reason of the posterior of the light of Keter, which remained standing in the Rosh and did not return to expand into the Guf in this second expansion; for this posterior diminishes the light of the GAR still more than it was at the time of the departure itself, and therefore it darkens upon the vessels more than the distance of three degrees. And therefore they became vessels now, at the time of the coming into being of the posterior of Keter beneath the Malchut of the Rosh.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:49:6
items.html: Male and female together in Keter, and male and female in Hochma. That the record of Keter of the first expansion became the male of Keter, and the record of Hochma of the first expansion became the male of Hochma; and the light of Hochma of the second expansion, which comes anew, became the female of Keter, and the light of Bina of the second expansion became the aspect of the female of the vessel of Hochma.
